name: dsh-sidebar-suite
author: Yonan
description: 一款专门针对改进 DSH 左侧栏体验的插件：标签页 / 浮层 / 官方默认三种布局一键切换、三段式页面切换（对话 / DeepSeek Chat / API，登录状态保存在本机）、默认布局在详情页顶部直接设、会话列表默认全展开、会话收藏（标题星标 + 可折叠「收藏夹」分组，可与 archive-manager 共用收藏）、「临时会话」开原生会话且默认在退出 DSH 时删除（DELETE_ON_EXIT 默认开；每天定时清理默认关，可在详情页开启并自设时间）、详情页三种反馈入口、临时会话可右键「保留为正式会话」、「立即删除」或「打开会话目录」、全部配置键都有图形开关且改文件免重启、Windows 启动时可选择把被其他应用盖住的主窗口恢复并置前 —— 强实用性；界面沿用宿主原生配色、圆角与间距，只加属性与一条控制栏、不重构宿主结构 —— 克制美观。｜A plugin dedicated to the DSH sidebar experience: one-click layouts (toggle, overlay, official default), a three-page switch (Agent / DeepSeek Chat / API with on-device login snapshots), always-expanded sessions, session favorites (title star + a collapsible 收藏夹 group, optionally sharing archive-manager's favorite set), native temp sessions deleted when DSH quits by default (DELETE_ON_EXIT on; daily cleanup off by default and opt-in) in-page settings/feedback, a right-click menu to keep, delete, or open the session folder of one temp session, a control for every config key and hot-reloaded config edits, plus an opt-in Windows launch switch that restores and foregrounds the main window when another app covers it — seriously practical; native colours, radii and spacing with zero host-DOM rewrites — restrained and good-looking.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/temp-session-host.mjs && node --check lib/web-login-host.mjs && node --check lib/window-focus-host.mjs && node --check lib/update-host.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-l5.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-compat.mjs && node --check scripts/run-tests.mjs && node --check scripts/coverage.mjs && npm pack --dry-run
